environment: Local isolated SQL sandbox; same base workflow and synthetic memberships
correctness: Notification selection matches authorized record reads for the reporter, dean, named counselor, unassigned counselor and administrator.
Reassignment stops notifications to the previous counselor and admits the new eligible counselor.
Verified participant access is honored; revoked participants and inactive users are excluded.
Shared grant and policy-fact helpers reject nonempty calls outside a transaction.
Existing durable attempt, retry, unchanged-revision delivery, RLS and real-connection concurrency tests remain enabled.
limitations: This measures statement volume, not hosted capacity or latency.
Per-pass notification deduplication and finance-topic narrowing remain pending.
A large membership population still requires one bounded pass through all eligible members.
Draft and save capture windows vary by one statement with asynchronous work; full deferred-cycle measurement remains pending.
